_doc: Per-faction colours and styles for effects, hulls and backdrops (G4). Linear RGB. Read by fx/faction_look.gd. Change a faction's look here, not in code. See fx/API.md section 15. Lore round 8 palettes (approved Oct 27): Sunward Crusade (voidsworn) black iron, frost white, bright ember; Hegemony pale grey, steel blue, implant blue; Ashfall Hullbreakers (corsair) soot, rust, red running lights; the Chorus dark olive, ochre, bile yellow-green; the Glasswrights (ithar) clear crystal, silver, rainbow edge, stored light; Eclipse (deathless) violet-black, white-gold corona, violet-white inner glow, no green.
_fields: All fields are in use. damage_glow: the fire and lit conduits inside hull damage, per faction (Crusade ember, Hegemony white-gold, Hullbreakers dirty red, Chorus bile, Glasswrights stored white light, Eclipse violet-white). accent: a corona round each engine core in a second colour (Crusade frost white, Hullbreakers red running lights, Glasswrights silver, Eclipse white-gold; Eclipse's engine embers take it too); null where a faction has none (Hegemony, Chorus). shield_edge: the shield bubble's rim (Crusade frost white, Glasswrights rainbow); null for the others. Ids never change.
